title: Protocol to identify centrosome-associated transcription factors during mitosis in mammalian cell lines
protocol: Culture cells in 3.5-cm virgin polystyrene plates to reach 20% confluence for 18-24 hours.
Replace the medium with 2 mL of fresh medium containing 2 mM thymidine and incubate at 37°C for 16 hours.
Remove the medium containing thymidine completely.
Wash cells twice with 2 mL pre-warmed 1× PBS buffer and discard the PBS.
Add 2 mL fresh medium without thymidine to the cells and place them in an incubator at 37°C for 8 hours.
Discard the medium and add 2 mL of fresh medium containing 2 mM thymidine again, incubating at 37°C for another 16 hours.
Wash cells twice with 2 mL pre-warmed 1× PBS buffer after synchronization.
Release cells into fresh medium without thymidine for 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, and 14 hours.
Discard the medium followed by washing cells carefully with 2 mL of 1× PBS buffer.
Store plates with cells in −80°C freezer until lysis.
Discard the medium from the cells.
Add 2 mL of pre-warmed (37°C) fresh medium containing 0.1% DMSO to the mitotic cells for 15 min in an incubator at 37°C.
Wash mitotic cells with caution using warm medium if they are adherent, or collect them by centrifuging suspended cells at 850 × g for 3 min.
Add 2 mL of pre-warmed (37°C) fresh medium containing 5 μM RO3306 to the mitotic cells for 15 min in an incubator at 37°C.
Add 2 mL of pre-warmed (37°C) fresh medium containing 0.25 μM BI2536 to the mitotic cells for 15 min in an incubator at 37°C.
Add 2 mL of pre-warmed (37°C) fresh medium containing 5 μM VX680 to the mitotic cells for 15 min in an incubator at 37°C.
Lysate cells in plates with RIPA buffer.
Measure protein concentration using BCA Protein Assay Kit.
Store cell lysates at −80°C before Western blot analysis.
Collect cells at the peak of mitosis for subsequent analysis including Western Blot, immunofluorescence, in situ PLA and centrosome isolation.
Monitor cell morphology under light microscope every other hour after release from TT block.
Release cells from TT block and collect samples at 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14 hours post-release for analysis.
Analyze collected cells by Western Blot using anti-pT210-PLK1 and anti-pS10-H3 antibodies.
Synchronize HeLa cells at the mitotic phase.
Add chemical inhibitors of Cdk1, PLK1, and Aurora A to mitotically synchronized cells.
Incubate cells with kinase inhibitors for a short duration to minimize indirect effects on phosphorylation.
Collect lysates from treated cells.
Perform sucrose density centrifugation to isolate centrosomal fractions.
Prepare whole cell extracts (WCE) from the isolated fractions.
Conduct Western blot analysis of centrosomal fractions and WCE to reveal endogenous pS56-RXRα localization.
Mount cells on an 8 mm × 8 mm round glass coverslip in a 24-well plate with 20% confluence for 18-24 hours.
Prepare the TT block (steps 2-5) as indicated.
Transfect cells with plasmids containing mCherry-tagged or EGFP-tagged transcription factor of interest during the second thymidine arrest.
Wash cells twice with 1 mL pre-warmed (37°C) 1× PBS buffer.
Release cells into fresh medium without thymidine for 10 h.

Discard the medium and add 500 μL pre-warmed (37°C) fresh medium containing 0.1% DMSO, 10 μM RO3306 (CDK1 inhibitor), or other inhibitors such as PLK1 inhibitor BI2536 or Aurora A inhibitor XV680 to mitotic cells for one more hour.
Wash cells once with 500 μL 1× PBS buffer per well and discard PBS.
Fix cells with 500 μL −20°C methanol for 10 min at 4°C or 4% paraformaldehyde prepared in 1× PBS buffer for 10 min at 20°C∼25°C.
Wash cells twice by 500 μL 1× PBS buffer.
Permeabilize cells with 500 μL 0.05% Triton X-100 in 1× PBS buffer for 8 min at 4°C.
Wash cells twice with 1× PBS again.
Block cells with 500 μL 1% Bovine Serum Albumin (BSA) in 1× PBS for 30 min at 20°C∼25°C.
Prepare blocking buffer right before use by mixing BSA in 1× PBS buffer.
Transfer coverslips from a 24-well plate to a covered dish.
Discard the blocking buffer carefully using a 20 μL pipette tip.
Incubate cells with 20 μL of primary antibody diluted at 1:100 for anti-RXRα, 1:200 for anti-PLK1, and 1:1,000 for anti-γ-tubulin in blocking buffer.
Remove the primary antibody after incubation.
Wash cells with 200 μL of 1× PBS three times for 5 minutes each.
Incubate cells with 20 μL of FITC-labeled Goat anti-Mouse IgG diluted at 1:200 to detect PLK1 or γ-tubulin and Cy3-labeled Goat anti-Rabbit IgG diluted at 1:200 to visualize RXRα in blocking buffer.
Cover the dish during incubation.
Remove the second antibody.
Stain cells with 20 μL of DAPI at a 1:10,000 dilution in 1× PBS at 20°C to 25°C for 5 minutes to visualize nuclei.
Discard the DAPI solution.
Wash cells twice with 200 μL of 1× PBS at room temperature (4 times total).
Tap off excess PBS from coverslips.
Wash coverslips in double distilled water for 3 seconds using tweezers.
Remove residual water from coverslips by gently touching the edges with a paper towel.
Mount coverslips on glass slides using 3 μL of mounting medium containing DAPI (if not used previously).
Dry slides at 20°C to 25°C in darkness for 2 hours before imaging.
Use conventional confocal microscopy for imaging.
Select the 40× or 63× oil objective for detailed observation.
Identify interphase and mitotic cells based on nuclear and chromosome morphology revealed by DAPI staining.
Examine subcellular localization of endogenous RXRα during mitosis.
Observe colocalization of RXRα with γ-tubulin, a centrosomal marker, during prophase.
Note increased RXRα association with the centrosome during prometaphase and metaphase.
Document RXRα return to the nucleus after cells exit from mitosis.
Identify colocalization of mCherry-tagged RXRα with PLK1 at the centrosome in mitotic cells.
Conclude that Cdk1-dependent phosphorylation is required for RXRα centrosomal translocation based on RO3306 inhibition results.
Store slides at -20°C in darkness after imaging.
Perform the transfection experiment once cells are released from first thymidine arrest.
Choose methanol as the fixing reagent for anti-γ-tubulin antibody.
Use either methanol or paraformaldehyde for anti-RXRα and anti-PLK1 antibodies.
Follow optimal fixation conditions found in antibody datasheets or related publications.
Conduct in situ proximity ligation assay (PLA).
Mount cells with 15%∼20% confluence on 8 mm× 8 mm round glass coverslip in a 24-well plate for 18∼24 h.
Perform TT block steps as specified.
Release cells into fresh medium without thymidine for 10 hours after washing twice with 1 mL pre-warmed (37°C) 1× PBS buffer.
Wash cells twice with 500 μL 1× PBS buffer and discard the PBS.
Fix cells with 500 μL cold methanol (−20°C) for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the fixing buffer and wash cells twice with 500 μL 1× PBS buffer.
Permeabilize cells with 500 μL 0.05% Triton X-100 in 1× PBS buffer for 8 minutes at 4°C.
Wash cells two times by 1× PBS and transfer the coverslips from 24-well plate to a covered dish containing wet cotton balls around the inner edge.
Block cells with a drop of Blocking Solution per coverslip for 60 minutes at 37°C incubator or run blocking for 12∼16 hours at 4°C.
Discard Blocking Solution and incubate cells with 25 μL primary antibody diluted in Antibody Diluent per coverslip for 60 minutes at 37°C incubator.
For an 8 mm x 8 mm round coverslip, use 25 μL of solution for coverage.
Use 20 μL pipette tips to tap off Blocking Solution as much as possible to prevent dilution of the primary antibody.
Dilute anti-RXRα antibody to a concentration of 1:100.
Dilute anit-PLK1 antibody to a concentration of 1:300.
Incubate cells with diluted primary antibodies for 12∼16 h at 4°C.
Discard the primary antibody solution and wash coverslips 4 × 5 min with 1× Wash Buffer A.
Tap off excess wash buffer to avoid dilution of the PLA probe solution.
Incubate cells with PLA labeled secondary antibodies (anti-mouse, MINUS; anti-rabbit, PLUS) for 60 min in a 37°C incubator.
For a 25 μL reaction, take 5 μL PLA probe MINUS stock and 5 μL PLA probe PLUS stock, then add 15 μL Antibody Diluent.
Discard the PLA probe solution and wash coverslips 4 × 5 min with 1× Wash Buffer A.
Add 25 μL of Ligation solution including ligase to each coverslip for 30 min at 37°C incubator.
Add 5 μL of 5× Ligation buffer to 20 μL ultrapure water to obtain 25 μL of 1× Ligation buffer.
Add 0.625 μL of Ligase to 24.375 μL of 1× Ligation buffer.
Wash coverslips 4 times for 5 minutes each with 1× Wash Buffer A.
Incubate cells with 25 μL of Amplification buffer including polymerase per coverslip for 100 minutes at 37°C.
Add 5 μL of 5× Amplification buffer to 20 μL ultrapure water to obtain 25 μL of 1× Amplification buffer.
Add 0.3125 μL of Polymerase to 24.6875 μL of 1× Amplification buffer.
Wash coverslips 3 times for 5 minutes each with 1× Wash Buffer B.
Wash coverslips once for 1 minute with 0.01× Wash Buffer B.
Tap off excess wash buffer from coverslips at the last step.
Mount coverslips using a minimal volume of mounting medium containing DAPI.
Seal the edge of coverslips to the glass slides with clear nail polish.
Transfer mounting medium to glass slide carefully and slowly by 20 μL pipette to avoid air bubbles under the coverslip.
Place glass slide in dark at 20°C to 25°C for 15 minutes before analyzing on a LEICA TCS SP8 confocal laser scanning microscope system.
Mix 15 mM sterile HCl with human recombinant leptin.
Prepare a fresh working solution for injection by mixing components 30 min before each time point.
Identify optimal conditions for primary antibodies using IF staining before PLA experiment.
Ensure reagents and buffers are prepared and stored under recommended conditions.
Thaw ligation buffer and amplification buffer completely prior to usage.
Perform all steps, particularly the primary antibody incubation step and enzymatic steps (ligation and amplification), at appropriate times for best results.
Release cells from TT block for 10 h in 10-cm plates (n=20).
Treat the released cells with 1 μg/mL cytochalasin D and 0.2 μM nocodazole for 1 hour at 37°C to disrupt actin cytoskeleton and microtubules.
Collect treated cells by centrifugation in a 50 mL tube at 350 × g for 8 minutes at 4°C.
Pipette up and down 3-5 times to detach cells from plates.
Wash cell pellet in 20 mL 1× PBS buffer.
Centrifuge cells at 350 × g for 8 minutes.
Resuspend cells in 20 mL of 0.1× PBS/8% sucrose.
Carefully handle swollen cells after resuspension.
Recentrifuge cells at 350 × g for 8 minutes.
Resuspend cell pellet in 2 mL 0.1× TBS/8% sucrose.
Add 8 mL lysis buffer to the cell suspension.
Pass cell suspension five times through a 10-mL narrow-mouth serological pipette.
Place cell lysate on ice for 5 minutes.
Take an aliquot of 50 μL as whole cell extract (WCE).
Store WCE in −80°C refrigerator.
Centrifuge cell lysate at 2,500 × g for 10 minutes to remove debris.
Filter supernatant through a 70 μm Nylon Cell Strainer into a 50 mL tube.
Add 1 M Hepes to the filtered supernatant to achieve final concentration of 10 mM Hepes.
Add DNase I to supernatant to reach final concentration of 1 μg/mL.
Mix well and incubate on ice for 30 minutes.
Gently underlay mixture with 1 mL of 60% sucrose solution.
Spin at 10,000 × g for 30 minutes to sediment centrosomes onto cushion.
Remove the upper 8 mL of the supernatant carefully.
Gently vortex the remainder, including the cushion, containing the concentrated centrosomes.
Prepare a discontinuous sucrose gradient by adding 3 mL of 70% sucrose solution to the centrifuge tube.
Add 3 mL of 50% sucrose solution along the inner wall of the centrifuge tube slowly using a Pasteur pipet.
Add 3 mL of 40% sucrose solution along the inner wall of the centrifuge tube slowly using a Pasteur pipet.
Load the concentrated centrosomes onto the discontinuous sucrose gradient from the bottom.
Spin at 25,600 × g for 1 hour in a Beckman Preparative Ultracentrifuge with an SW28 rotor.
Collect fractions by 200 μL/fraction using a Piston Gradient Fractionator (BIOCOMP).
Boil fractions in SDS sample loading buffer with 20 μL/fraction.
Store fractions at −80°C refrigerator for further analysis.
Mix pS56-RXRα with γ-tubulin to study co-localization.
Use β-actin as a negative control for the experiment.
Use Lamin B1 as another negative control for the experiment.
Treat cells with cytochalasin D and nocodazole.
Suspension of mitotic cells into culture media by pipetting or using a horizontal shaker after treatment.
Optimize MgCl2 concentration during lysis step to 0.5 mM for HeLa cells.
